title: Evaluating Ukrainian Grammatical Competence in Language Models: Probability Versus Prompting
abstract: arXiv:2611.34016v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Organisations deploying large language models in Ukrainian-language information systems need to know whether a model produces normative Ukrainian. This paper establishes a protocol for measuring that reliably and applies it to 19 models. The instrument is a released set of 1,444 Ukrainian minimal pairs covering the vocative case, numeral-noun and adjective agreement, verb government and calques from russian, with subject-verb agreement as a control; a quarter of the set was checked against the answer key in two independent native-speaker ratings, which agreed at Cohen's $\kappa$ = 0.963. Every pair is scored twice: by comparing the probabilities a model assigns to the two sentences, and by asking the model directly, with the sentences presented in both orders so that answer-position effects are measured instead of being absorbed into the score. translated_title: 评估语言模型中的乌克兰语语法能力：概率法与提示法之比较
translated_abstract: 在乌克兰语信息系统中部署大语言模型的机构需要了解模型能否产出符合规范的乌克兰语。本文建立了一套可靠的测量协议，并将其应用于19个模型。测评工具是一套公开发布的、包含1,444个乌克兰语最小对立对的题集，涵盖呼格、数词与名词的一致、形容词一致、动词支配以及源自俄语的仿译词，并以主谓一致作为对照；其中四分之一的题目由两名母语者依据答案键进行独立评分核查，两者一致性达到 Cohen's κ = 0.963。每一对句子均采用两种方式评分：一是比较模型赋予两个句子的概率，二是直接向模型提问，且两个句子以两种顺序呈现，从而测量答案位置效应而非将其吸收进总分中。由此得出三项结果。顺序一致性（即当句子顺序……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了一套包含1,444个乌克兰语最小对立对的语法评测协议，通过比较概率与直接提示两种方法评估19个语言模型的规范乌克兰语语法能力，并显式控制句子呈现顺序带来的答案位置效应。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a reliable evaluation protocol of 1,444 Ukrainian minimal pairs to assess the grammatical competence of 19 language models, comparing probability-based scoring with direct prompting while controlling for answer-position effects.
